concern_summary: This aggregate concern combines the determination of emoji font sizes with button size management, focusing on ensuring a cohesive and user-friendly interface for emoji reaction buttons.
This concern addresses the visual appearance and layout of varying button sizes, including the emoji reaction button, ensuring usability and proper interaction in the UI.
This concern focuses on determining and applying appropriate font sizes for emoji based on message content, ensuring consistent styling for emoji reactions.

This concern includes functionalities that calculate and apply font sizes for emojis dynamically based on message context and screen size, ensuring that emojis are displayed legibly in varying conditions.
This concern involves the functionalities for displaying and interacting with an emoji picker, allowing users to select and insert emoji reactions efficiently.
This concern focuses on managing user interactions with emoji reactions, including the addition and removal of reactions based on user input and existing reactions.
This concern gathers functionalities related to retrieving and managing information about emoji reactions, including the count of reactions, user interactions, and associated data for reports.

This concern encompasses the functionalities related to adding, removing, toggling, and displaying emoji reactions associated with report actions, allowing users to express feelings and view the reactions of others.
This concern is centered around handling the opening and management of the emoji picker within the user interface, ensuring proper interaction and visibility for emoji selection.
This concern addresses functionalities for managing user reactions, including display and interaction capabilities, allowing users to see and engage with who has reacted.
